name: resident_report
query:
SELECT
    r.resident_id AS "Resident ID:Data:120",
    r.user_name AS "Resident Name:Data:180",
    r.email AS "Email:Data:200",
    r.moble_number AS "Mobile:Data:120",
    r.block AS "Block:Data:80",

    a.apartment_name AS "Apartment:Data:180",
    a.place AS "Place:Data:150",
    a.address AS "Address:Data:220",

    p.problem_id AS "Problem ID:Data:120",
    p.problem AS "Problem:Data:250",
    p.category AS "Category:Data:120",
    p.status AS "Status:Data:120",
    p.date_time AS "Complaint Date:Datetime:160",
    p.due_time AS "Due Date:Date:120",
    p.completed_date AS "Completed Date:Datetime:160"

FROM `tabResident` r

LEFT JOIN `tabapartment_details` a
ON a.name = r.apartment_name

LEFT JOIN `tabproblems` p
ON p.parent = r.name

ORDER BY r.user_name;
